title: Housing and remote-session continuity through four complete Klein receipts

reviews.classification: bounded historical content journeys; physical/economic/source gaps and corrected attempts preserved
reviews.disposition: KJ3N's fifteen acts preserve nine intents and the Sunday housing/move window; the eight-slice F–M replay is a separate B9 compatibility observation with identical money/place/clock, not proof every earlier mechanism is complete. Pinned original artifacts were restored and replay copies kept separately. A detached browser-launch failure was not a game failure. Original run6 hit the real B9 refusal; run7 hit a false-positive leak regex; run8 exposed a calendar placement error; final run9 used 870 rather than 300 fill minutes and ended clock4956. That evidence does not prove a general civil-clock repair. The native bread debit is nine pence, while eight pounds is bread weight; 2731→2722 remains a money ceiling due to earlier unpriced purchases. The pooled deposit/rent/notary sums are facts, not personal purse debits; weekly147pence exists without a due-date/payer mechanism. The suit's1920pence price is outside this window and belongs to kjw5. Three key bunches are an explicit assumption; Franky/Frank identity remains probable, whereas the address/Scarth matches have their stated alias basis. Lease termination, contracts, locks and moved belongings in notes do not establish lease/property/item consumers. The 582.6-second native route and literal import are historical B9 proof, without a new build, full suite, font matrix or civil-clock exercise. Earlier secrets stay withheld by route; next-window requirements are continuation data, not instructions to run private scripts.

reviews.classification: bounded historical content journeys; physical/economic/source gaps and corrected attempts preserved
reviews.disposition: KJ3Q ends inside a live second remote gathering, not at a closed session or completed whole gathering feature. Nineteen acts are preserved one-to-one. Three seat relocations in link plus the active fact were validated; a second session reused existing support and did not require the proposed B11 engine change. This local Q3/B11 hypothesis differs from KJ3S's later actor-enrolment backlog B11. Actual session projection stays active/ready with connected seats across literal import/reload, while the gathering view was not visually checked. Source pool3/0→2/1→1/2→0/3 is metered fixed-outcome use, not functional Spirit Vision switching/exhaustion, aura inspection or recovery at exhaustion. The ritual remains authored, parchment/pen remain notes, imprint is a fact on an original, and trade flags are not inventory transfers. Money802 remains a ceiling; meal prose consumes no supplies here. The second run corrected a guidance/dance regex false positive rather than a game defect; the reader-row hard failure outside the window was excluded, not repaired or dismissed globally. 129-minute study was accepted on this B10 bundle, not a general clock proof. Known anchors differ from remaining fill minutes. No source build, full suite, font captures or civil-clock test ran in this receipt. The successor must close the session before travel, retaining the distinction between projection data and rendered UI.

reviews.classification: bounded historical content journeys; physical/economic/source gaps and corrected attempts preserved
reviews.disposition: KJ3R closes the live session with its active fact false and all three seats parked, then exercises the first permitted move and durable closed-session state. That proves bounded closure on B10; remoteMeetings data was read, not visually reviewed. The introduction says four scenes but names only tail/fog/errand, so the scene count is unconfirmed here rather than silently inventing a fourth; sixteen acts are the specified content count. Return recovery and two later metered uses reach3/0→2/1→1/2 without implementing on/off vision, passive perception or borrowed emotion. Wendy's initial NOT_PLACED defect was fixed by actual arrival/visit placement. Attendant/Glacis/Vincent remained text roles, with Glacis enrolment carried to the next brief and no backlog row written in R. World trade facts, not the stale legacy ledger, remain the authoritative flags in this historical journey. Club fees and reader quotations are not payments: money802 unchanged, membership1200 first year/240 later, quoted48 and2pence distinct. Authored movement is not the engine's free walk route. The one-hour text anchor is separate from other fill durations and no civil-clock verification follows. M1–M4 remain unbuilt proposals, and no native rerun/build/full suite/font matrix is implied by the first successful294.1-second journey and persistence checks.

reviews.classification: bounded historical content journeys; physical/economic/source gaps and corrected attempts preserved
reviews.disposition: KJ3S supplies sixteen authored acts but keeps the divination mechanism unprobed: card names/outcomes and aura observations are fixed facts, not the native query adapter, switch condition or a new measured divination result. Glacis remained a text role despite R's carried enrolment need; S explicitly filed actor-enrolment B11 rather than claiming that need delivered. Topaz room/corridor and Bredt also remain text, not placed rooms/actors. Leonard/Rozanne/Melissa receive actual arrival/visit placements; Melissa's initial ambiguous presence was corrected. Two actual two-pence costs give802→800→798, still a ceiling; wage/rent/fare calculations, the offstage allowance and unpriced home fare are notes rather than completed economy mechanisms. Drawn bullets and practice do not change inventory or rounds5, so B8 custody/ammunition/training remains open. One metered aura use reaches0/3; the later thinking tap is not a second use. The final6905 clock follows labelled fill and retains the source afternoon/darkness tension rather than proving civil time. The next source boundary is the next morning, but the saved checkpoint is evening with sleep/recovery as the next act. Closed session, money/pool/facts survive literal import/reload on historical B10. No new build, full suite, actual14/21px screenshots or current source verification was performed.
